name: Radius Booking — Booking Calendar for Appointments & Services
author: RadiusTheme

sections.description:
Radius Booking is a smart appointment scheduling solution built for service-based businesses. Whether you run a salon, clinic, consulting firm, or fitness studio, this plugin helps you manage bookings directly from your WordPress website.

What makes Radius Booking different? It uses artificial intelligence to simplify the booking process. Instead of clicking through complex forms, your customers can book appointments using natural language. Just type what you need, and the system understands.

Who Should Use This Plugin?

Radius Booking works well for many types of businesses:

  • Salons and Spas — Hair stylists, nail technicians, massage therapists
  • Healthcare Providers — Doctors, dentists, clinics, therapists
  • Home Services — Roofing contractors, plumbers, electricians, cleaners
  • Education — Tutors, coaches, music teachers, language instructors
  • Fitness — Gyms, personal trainers, yoga studios, fitness coaches
  • Professional Services — Consultants, lawyers, accountants, agencies
  • Multi-location Businesses — Franchises, chains, businesses with multiple offices

Why Choose Radius Booking?

Simple for Your Customers
Your clients can book appointments quickly without confusion. The clean interface works perfectly on phones, tablets, and computers.

Powerful for Your Business
Manage your entire booking operation from one dashboard. Track appointments, staff schedules, services, and payments in one place.

AI That Actually Helps
The Pro version includes intelligent features that learn from your booking patterns. Get smart recommendations and automated optimizations that save you time.

Key Features

Free Version

Everything you need to start accepting online bookings:

  • Appointment Booking Calendar — A clean, easy-to-use calendar for managing all your bookings
  • Service Management — Create and organize your services with descriptions, durations, and pricing
  • Staff Management — Add team members and assign them to specific services
  • Booking Form Builder — Customize your booking forms to collect the information you need
  • Email Notifications — Automatic emails for booking confirmations, reminders, and updates
  • Custom Fields — Add extra fields to gather specific information from customers
  • Analytics Dashboard — Basic reports to track your booking performance
  • Mobile-Friendly Design — Works smoothly on all devices
  • Google Calendar Sync — Connect with Google Calendar to avoid double bookings
  • Shortcodes and Blocks — Easy placement on any page using shortcodes or the block editor
  • Multi-Location Support — Manage bookings across different business locations
  • Office Location Management — Set up and organize your physical locations

Pro Version

Advanced features for growing businesses:

  • AI-Powered Booking Optimization — Smart algorithms that improve your scheduling efficiency
  • AI Appointment Recommendations — Intelligent suggestions based on customer preferences and availability
  • Advanced Analytics and Reporting — Detailed insights into your booking trends and business performance
  • Stripe Payment Integration — Accept secure online payments directly through your booking forms
  • Multiple Payment Gateways — Support for various payment methods to suit your customers
  • Coupons and Discount System — Create promotional codes and special offers
  • Advanced Custom Fields — More field types and conditional logic for complex booking needs
  • Staff Scheduling — Detailed availability management for each team member
  • Recurring Appointments — Set up repeat bookings for regular customers
  • Multi-Location and Multi-Staff Scheduling — Advanced coordination across locations and team members
  • Automated Reminders — Email and SMS notifications to reduce no-shows
  • Advanced Booking Rules — Custom rules for booking windows, cancellation policies, and more
  • Priority Support — Fast, dedicated help when you need it

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • MySQL 5.6 or higher
  • HTTPS recommended for secure bookings
  • Modern web browser for admin interface

Additional Information

For documentation, tutorials, and support, visit our website. We’re committed to helping you get the most out of Radius Booking for your business.

If you enjoy using Radius Booking, please consider leaving a review. Your feedback helps other business owners discover the plugin and helps us improve.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Radius Booking”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the zip file and click Install Now
  5. Activate the plugin

After Activation

  1. Go to Radius Booking in your WordPress menu
  2. Follow the setup wizard to configure your business details
  3. Add your services and staff members
  4. Place the booking calendar on your desired page using the shortcode or block
  5. Start accepting appointments
sections.faq:
Is Radius Booking free to use?

Yes, the core plugin is completely free. It includes all the essential features for appointment booking. The Pro version adds advanced capabilities like AI optimization, payment processing, and automated reminders.

Does it work with my WordPress theme?

Radius Booking is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme. The booking calendar adapts to your site’s styling automatically.

Can I accept online payments?

Payment processing is available in the Pro version. It supports Stripe and multiple other payment gateways for secure transactions.

How does the AI booking feature work?

The AI system learns from your booking patterns and customer behavior. It suggests optimal time slots, predicts busy periods, and helps reduce scheduling conflicts. This feature is available in the Pro version.

Can I manage multiple locations?

Yes, both the free and Pro versions support multiple business locations. You can manage separate calendars, staff, and services for each location.

Does it send booking reminders?

The free version includes email notifications for confirmations. The Pro version adds automated email and SMS reminders to help reduce no-shows.

Can my staff manage their own schedules?

Yes, you can create staff accounts with appropriate permissions. Team members can view and manage their appointments based on the access level you assign.

Is customer data secure?

Radius Booking follows WordPress security best practices. All data is stored securely in your WordPress database, and payment processing uses industry-standard encryption.

Can I customize the booking form?

Absolutely. The form builder lets you add, remove, and rearrange fields. You can collect exactly the information your business needs.

Does it sync with external calendars?

The plugin supports Google Calendar synchronization. This helps prevent double bookings when you manage appointments across different platforms.
